text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I began overseeing
Biko Pegasus's training.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's not dirt, it's not dirt... Don't forget just 'cause you're getting used to it...!
choice_data_list: Focus on the bounce of the turf! Spring off it!
Focus on the bounce of the turf! Spring off it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!!
Justice Biko never forgets a lesson!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to Biko Pegasus's honest, hardworking nature,
her transition from dirt to turf is going swimmingly.
choice_data_list: —At this rate, you'll definitely be a contender!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Does that mean—
choice_data_list: Let's enter you in turf for the upcoming Category Meet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Category Meet is an event where Umamusume compete under their preferred conditions.
At the rate she's progressing, registering her for a turf race shouldn't be a problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I really get to run on turf...!!
Thank you so much, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy!! Because, you see—
I came to Tracen Academy because I wanted to run on turf just like Carrotman!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Come on, we watched it together the other day!
My absolute favorite episode! 'Carrotman's Pretty Debut!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall what we watched in the trainer's office recently. If I remember correctly,
it was an episode where Carrotman ran on the turf to encourage a sick Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"You will run again. And to prove it to you—
I will make the impossible possible!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hero with zero racing experience takes on and defeats professionals on the turf.
It was supposed to be an impossible challenge, but—

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how reckless it is... I will never give up!!
I'm just getting started—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrotman never gave up, blazing past the other runners one by one.
It was a beautiful scene—Carrotman racing straight across the vibrant green turf.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I came here because I wanted to be a hero like that...
someone who gives courage to others! I wanted to run just like him!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To me, Carrotman is the 'ultimate hero'...
I looked up to him so much, and I copied everything he did.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So right now! Being able to run on turf
makes me feel like I'm one step closer to my 'ultimate' ideal... and I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Go! Rise up! Carrot~♪
Coursing through my veins are~ love and~ courage and~♪ Ca~ro~te~ne~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus expresses her joy with her whole body.
To make sure we don't let this momentum go to waste, let's fire her up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! Roger that, Captain!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Lately you've been acting just like Captain Onion, Trainer!
The commander who encourages Carrotman with both tough love and gentle support!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Looking up to Captain Onion makes Carrotman fire on all cylinders...
because he wants to show off his coolest side!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And guess what... I feel the exact same way!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Category Meet drew near—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, aren't there a lot of people around today?
Is something happening?
choice_data_list: Apparently there's a practice race about to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it isn't just any practice race.
Standing at the center of the crowd's gaze is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Brian. That remarkably imposing Umamusume
is a formidable rival whose debut is already set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a truly ferocious run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A signature low-crouched form,
backed by the pure physical prowess of an apex predator that lets her seize any position at will.
choice_data_list: Incredible... She's even better than the rumors!
Incredible... She's even better than the rumors!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, no kidding...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —On our way back after training.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...That was so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran with all her might, like she was chewing up the turf...
So heavy, so powerful, so impossible to ignore...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...She looked so commanding, just like a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ack, no, no, no!!
What am I thinking?! There's no way I could ever copy something like that!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm short, so my reach is shorter too!
Trainer said that means I gotta win with tight turns and sheer cadence!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Trainer said that, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (Trainer was also... praising Brian's running...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (Me, scurrying around with my tiny body, versus Brian, running so cool and majestic...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wonder which one Trainer thinks is a "cool hero"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—Biko Pegasus clocked in a terrible time, two whole seconds slower than the day before.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...!
choice_data_list: Why were you running so unlike yourself...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wide-stride form and an overly bold pathing. It was practically the exact opposite of her usual pitch-running style.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, you see... Brian looked so awesome yesterday!
So I just thought, maybe I'd give it a shot, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Total disaster though! Haha, guess it's no surprise I couldn't pull it off!!
Our running styles are completely different anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She saw something cool and wanted to try it out. If that was truly all it was, there wouldn't be an issue...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ............It's fine! Next time, I'll go right back to my normal style!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling there's more to this. What could be going through her head...?
